user.title: Media Content Guard – new rule
user.description: Keep unwanted content off your speakers. Pick the media players to watch and enter the keywords to block. As soon as one of these players plays something whose title, album, artist (or other selected details) contains a keyword, playback is stopped.

data_description.name: Shown as device name and used by the actions (e.g. `Living room` or `Kids content`). Must be unique.
data_description.players: One or more players. A player may also be part of several rules.
data_description.keywords: Upper/lower case does not matter and parts of words are enough: `bibi` also blocks “Bibi Blocksberg”. Empty lines are ignored.
data_description.fields: Media details that are searched for the keywords. Title, album, artist and content ID cover almost everything.

error.no_players: Select at least one media player.
error.no_fields: Select at least one detail to check.

missing_players.title: Media Content Guard: players missing for {name}
missing_players.description:
The rule **{name}** watches media players that no longer exist: {entities}

These players are **not protected**. If you renamed or replaced a speaker, open **Settings → Devices & services → Media Content Guard → {name} → Configure** and select the current players.
